final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.event_type, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
